description: SYNTHORA weather-now: current weather for any city or lat,lon — temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind, WMO condition code in plain text, plus the 6h temperature trend (rising/falling/flat), which is the actionable part. Free source: open-meteo.com (ECMWF/NOAA/DWD), no API key, timestamped. [x402: 0.01 USDC per call on Base]
